name: tattlebun
description: Keeps a receipt of what each agent command changed on your PC outside the repo. Needs the Tattlebun app.

hook_path.title: tattlebun-hook.exe
hook_path.description: Where Tattlebun installed tattlebun-hook.exe, usually %LOCALAPPDATA%\Tattlebun\current\tattlebun-hook.exe. The Tattlebun tray app shows the exact path.
